approved_scope.title: The handoff must not claim a commit it did not check
approved_scope.description: the handoff must not claim a commit it did not check
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-change-093 already says a current verification is safe and the reason names where a session resumes. The sentence claimed a commit HandoffSignals does not record.
acceptance_criteria: The verifying handoff says verification is current for this working tree and a fresh session here resumes at the independent review. It does not say the implementation is committed. The approved and implementing handoff does not say the tree is committed.

answers.constraints: Verification currency is whether this working tree matches the recorded verification. Evidence under .specsync/ stays uncommitted until finalize, so a handoff reason must not call that a commit.
